verdict.rationale: Postman's core product lets developers save requests into collections/folders, run them via the CLI or GUI, and reuse them anytime, corroborated by first-party docs (grouping requests in collections, scripting, CI/CD reruns) and independent community confirmation of exactly this workflow ("You can save requests in collections so you can rerun the same requests for testing purposes"). Missing for 10: no first-party doc explicitly discussing folder-nesting UI specifics, relying on general 'collections' framing plus a single community corroboration.
